visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a grey button-up cardigan over a black top, sits at a large brown grand piano. She holds a tan-colored music book titled 'Ghibli Best Album' and enthusiastically presents it to the camera. The background is a clean, white-paneled studio wall. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up overhead shot of the book's index page, showing a dense list of song titles in Japanese and English, indicating a comprehensive collection. (3) The woman returns to the eye-level shot, holding the book and gesturing with her hands as she explains its contents. She has an expressive, smiling facial expression. (4) The woman crosses her arms and looks slightly to the side with a mock-serious expression before breaking into a smile. A small circular graphic with Japanese text and a brain icon appears in the top right corner. (5) An inset video appears on the right showing a young boy wearing glasses and a headset, talking on a smartphone. The woman points toward him. Floating graphic symbols of chemical formulas and mathematical equations appear around her head to signify thought. (6) The woman gestures excitedly toward the music book placed on the piano's stand. She looks directly at the camera, pointing her finger to emphasize her point. A colorful graphic with the text '初學者福音' and cartoon sun/child faces appears over the bottom right of the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 江老師 譜譜瘋. (2) [Slogan]: 新色報到. [Variety]: 咖皮. [Subtitle]: 那這一次綠皮它那個宮崎駿出了全新的新版變成. (3) [Variety]: 熱門曲目齊全 每首都是精簡兩頁. [Subtitle]: 熟知的這個動畫的最受歡迎的那幾首全部都收錄在裡面，所以等於是你一次買這本你可以收集到所有的宮崎駿動畫的最棒的最棒的那幾首配樂. (4) [Logo]: ナウシカ. [Subtitle]: 結尾的相當特別哦. (5) [Variety]: 媽請好好說話. [Subtitle]: 這個我相信芒果. (6) [Variety]: 為母陷入思考. [Subtitle]: 應該練個一天或兩天也都是可以彈起來的程度. (7) [Variety]: 初學者福音. [Subtitle]: 所以我覺得這一本真的是很適合給很小的小朋友們，他們都有可能可以練習成功.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female speech begins immediately with a bright, percussive piano BGM. The voice is clear with high pitch variability. A metallic 'ding' SFX punctuates the mention of the new book. (2) Vocal delivery speeds up as she describes the song list. The BGM remains steady with a cheerful, rhythmic piano melody. Paper rustling is faintly heard during the book display. (3) A digital 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the visual cut back to the speaker. The tone remains enthusiastic. (4) A bubbly cartoon 'pop' sound effect occurs as text overlays appear. The vocal tone shifts slightly into a humorous, mock-serious register. (5) Muffled, low-fidelity child's voice enters via an inset, sounding like a phone call. The female voice responds with a lower-pitch 'hmm' thinking sound. (6) The female voice returns to a high-arousal peak, excitedly recommending the book. A shimmering 'twinkle' SFX plays as the final 'Gospel for beginners' graphic appears. BGM swells slightly in brightness before the clip ends.

The creator leverages her personality and professional setting (the piano studio) to highlight the book's comprehensive content and ease of use, specifically targeting beginners and children.
